description: This file defines a React functional component called U2FView, which manages the UI for U2F (Universal 2nd Factor) security devices, including listing existing devices, handling errors, and providing a modal to add new devices.

methods.name: U2FView
methods.description: React functional component rendering U2F device management UI.

methods.name: handleAddDeviceClick
methods.description: Handles the click event to show the device adding modal.

methods.name: loadAuthenticatorDevices
methods.description: Asynchronously loads U2F devices/authenticators and updates the state with the list or error.
